description: 后对h兵（车路兵）— 黑王在角落，必然平局

intro.popup_en: Warning: the rook-pawn corner trap. With an h-pawn and the black king already in the corner, the position is a theoretical draw. White cannot escape perpetual check; watch the pattern.
intro.popup:
⚠️ 车路兵角落陷阱！
h兵+黑王已在角落 = 必然平局。
白方无论如何都逃不出永续将的命运——看清楚！

outro.popup_en: Draw by the rook-pawn corner rule: with the black king on h1, the queen can give checks but cannot force the king out of the corner while also stopping promotion. An h-pawn with the king in the corner is a draw.
outro.popup:
🤝 平局！车路兵角落定律：
当黑王在h1角，白后只能无休止将军，无法让王离开角落又阻升变。
记住：h兵+黑王在角 = 永远平局！

moves.popup_en: White tries to drive the black king away with check.
moves.popup: 白尝试将军——逼黑王离角。

moves.popup_en: ...Kg1 escapes toward g1 but remains in the corner area.
White checks again, forcing the black king to move.
...Kg2. The black king shuttles between squares near the corner and never leaves the drawing zone.
moves.popup: 黑王来回游走……永远不脱离角落。

moves.popup_en: Perpetual check! White cannot make progress. Threefold repetition confirms the draw.
moves.popup: 🤝 永续将！白方无法突破——三次重复，平局。
